title: 고등교육기관의 자체평가에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00021:20081218:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum <Ordinance No. 21, December 18, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 2009.

Article 2 (Applicability to Self-Evaluation)
The first self-evaluation after these Rules enter into force shall be conducted by December 31, 2009, in the case of universities, industrial universities, universities of education, and cyber universities among schools under Article 2 of the Higher Education Act, and by December 31, 2010, in the case of junior colleges, technical colleges, and miscellaneous schools.
